authority: Project lead under existing autonomous CNY10000 research mandate
rule: Original eligibility, first-tranche identity, strict next-session entry,20session exit and no-overlap convention unchanged.
rounding: Decimal inputs from string. Buy price rounded up and sell price rounded down to0.001CNY after multiplicative adverse slippage; this is a conservative modeled quote, not a fill. Commission per side=max(minimum,notional*0.0005),rounded half-up to0.01CNY. Dividend entitlement credited gross per share, no reinvestment; cash pay-date availability is not modeled.
quantity: Largest100share lot quantity whose buy notional+buy commission is<=1000CNY. Zero quantity remains zero-PnL event in every mean/win denominator; executed counts separate.
dividend_entitlement: entry_date<=record_date<exit_date, with next-session ex-date validated. No split/reinvestment; conditional11distribution source review retained.

bootstrap.unit: entry calendar year cluster, all2013..2024 including empty years
bootstrap.statistic: resampled total net PnL / resampled opportunity count; includes unfilled events
bootstrap.zero_count_replication: value0, retained in quantiles and counted

descriptive_comparisons.duration_matched: Nonoverlapping20session intervals on calendar grid anchored first2013session; last incomplete interval excluded. Main-cost per-opportunity mean with same1000CNY cap. All calendar intervals retained regardless of event overlap. Different period mix; no timing-alpha qualification.
descriptive_comparisons.buy_and_hold: First2013session open to2024-06-28open, main costs and1000CNY cap, all entitled gross cash, no reinvestment. Different exposure duration, descriptive only.

account_interpretation: Sum of endpoint event PnL divided by10000 is reference-capital contribution only, not a full-account equity curve, CAGR, daily loss test or drawdown result.
